entities.summary: Natalya Aleksandrovna Kachuevskaya née Spirova was a combat medic in the Red Army during World War II who committed suicide with a grenade when surrounded, taking out several enemy soldiers in her death as well as avoiding capture. She was posthumously awarded the title Hero of the Russian Federation in 1997.
